title: Cloud Voice selection - enable one or more cloud providers here
Include Google Cloud TTS voices (master switch for Google voices in Space Chatter)
desc: (Requires a Google Cloud account to be created and configured) - whether to include Google Cloud voices in list of possible voices assigned to a character.

title: Use Google Standard quality voices
desc: (Requires a Google Cloud account to be created and configured and Include Google Cloud TTS voices (above) to be enabled) - whether to use Standard quality voices in Space Chatter.

title: Use Google WaveNet quality voices
desc: (Requires a Google Cloud account to be created and configured and Include Google Cloud TTS voices (above) to be enabled) - whether to use WaveNet quality voices in Space Chatter.

title: Use Google Neural2 quality voices
desc: (Requires a Google Cloud account to be created and configured and Include Google Cloud TTS voices (above) to be enabled) - whether to use Neural2 quality voices in Space Chatter.

title: Use Google Chirp-HD quality voices
desc: (Requires a Google Cloud account to be created and configured and Include Google Cloud TTS voices (above) to be enabled) - whether to use Chirp-HD quality voices in Space Chatter.

title: Use Google Studio quality voices
desc: (Requires a Google Cloud account to be created and configured and Include Google Cloud TTS voices (above) to be enabled) - whether to use Studio quality voices in Space Chatter.

title: Include Amazon Polly voices
desc: (Requires an Amazon AWS account to be created and configured) - whether to include Amazon Polly voices in list of possible voices assigned to a character.

title: Include Azure voices
desc: (Requires a Microsoft Azure account to be created and configured) - whether to include Azure cloud voices in list of possible voices assigned to a character.

title: Include Edge voices
desc: Whether to include Edge voices in list of possible voices assigned to a character.

title: Use ElevenLabs voices (for assigned characters only)
desc: If you have an ElevenLabs account you can assign a specific voice to a member of crew (for CrewChatter) or to your fleet carrier captain. Manual config currently required for this). IMPORTANT REMINDERS: 1. You are solely responsible for ensuring you have permission to use cloned or custom voices, particularly in public broadcasts or shared audio/video content. EDCoPilot does not assume liability for any misuse. Use of unauthorized voices may violate intellectual property laws and is done entirely at your own risk 2. You are responsible for usage charges on your Cloud voice account.

title: Use child-like voices
desc: If ON, will include the child-like cloud voices voices in its voice assignments.

title: Use non-native English voices
desc: If ON, will include non-native voices in its voice assignments. Will result in characters speaking accented-English
